termos.intro_html:
These Terms of Use set out the rules for using the Kronografx website (kronografx.com). They explain what you can do here, how we look after our content and third-party content, how quotes work, and what the rights and responsibilities of each party are. We wrote them in plain language on purpose. If you have any questions, just get in touch.

How we process personal data is explained in our Privacy Policy, which complements these Terms. It is an informational document: the processing of your data does not depend on you “accepting” the Policy, but on the legal bases set out in the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais – LGPD (Brazil's General Data Protection Law), which the Policy describes.

secoes.corpo_html:
These Terms are available at any time via the link in the site's footer. By using the site, you agree to follow the rules set out here. If you disagree with any point, we ask that you not use the site and, if you wish, tell us why through our contact channels.

The site is free of charge. These Terms cover the use of the site. Hiring us for a project is governed by the proposal or contract agreed in writing with you (see the “Quotes and hiring” section).

secoes.titulo: Who we are and what this site is
secoes.corpo_html:
Kronografx (CNPJ, Brazil's National Registry of Legal Entities, no. 69.317.795/0001-62) is a motion design, VFX (visual effects) and post-production studio. We serve clients all over Brazil 100% online: meetings, approvals and deliveries all happen over the internet.

This site is our showcase. Here you'll find:

  • information about the studio, our tools and the way we work;
  • the portfolio, with projects made for clients and conceptual projects, which are identified as conceptual on each project's page;
  • answers to frequently asked questions;
  • links to contact us via WhatsApp, email or Instagram.

The site has no sign-up, password access, client area, store or payment. Nothing is sold or charged here: services are agreed directly with you, as explained below.

You may:

  • browse the site and watch the videos to get to know our work;
  • share the page links with other people;
  • get in touch to ask questions or request a proposal.

You may not:

  • download for reuse, copy, edit, republish or commercially use the site's videos, images, texts, brand or visual identity without written authorization from Kronografx and, where applicable, from the client or other rights holder;
  • present work from our portfolio as if it were yours or someone else's;
  • use the Kronografx name or brand in a way that suggests a partnership or sponsorship, or that you speak on behalf of the studio;
  • attempt to break into, overload, alter or impair the operation of the site or the server where it is hosted, or insert any malicious code into it;
  • use our contact channels to send unsolicited bulk messages, scams, or illegal or offensive content, or to impersonate another person or company;
  • use the site for any purpose contrary to the law or to these Terms.

These rules do not prevent uses that the law itself allows without authorization, such as quoting excerpts for study, criticism or debate, crediting the author and the source, within the limits of Lei nº 9.610/1998 (Lei de Direitos Autorais, Brazil's Copyright Law). If these Terms are breached, we may take appropriate measures to protect our rights and those of third parties.

The items below belong to Kronografx or are used with the authorization of their respective owners, and are protected by Brazilian law, in particular by Lei nº 9.610/1998 (Lei de Direitos Autorais) and, as regards the brand, by Lei nº 9.279/1996 (Lei de Propriedade Industrial, Brazil's Industrial Property Law):

  • the site's videos, animations, images and texts;
  • the Kronografx name, logo and the studio's visual identity.

Some items belong to other people or companies:

  • Work made for clients, such as the project “3 Sinais” (“3 Signs”) for E2 Finanças, may contain the client's trademarks, texts and materials, which remain the client's property. This work appears in the portfolio with the client's authorization.
  • Other companies' trademarks that appear in the portfolio belong to their owners (see the next section).
  • Typefaces and other third-party resources used on the site belong to their authors and are used under their respective licenses.

Accessing the site does not transfer to you any rights over this content. For any use that goes beyond browsing, sharing links and the uses the law allows, such as displaying our work elsewhere, ask for authorization by emailing contato@kronografx.com.

Part of the portfolio consists of conceptual projects: pieces that Kronografx itself created to showcase technique and style, without a request from the brand owner. The current conceptual projects are:

  • “Um único app” (“One single app”), featuring the Itaú brand, with no affiliation with Itaú Unibanco;
  • “Seu nome no café” (“Your name on the cup”), featuring the Starbucks brand, with no affiliation with Starbucks.

They are not official advertisements: Itaú Unibanco and Starbucks did not commission, approve or sponsor them, and each conceptual project's page carries this notice. The names, logos and other signs of these brands belong to their owners. They appear only to identify the brand used in the creative portfolio exercise. We don't sell these companies' products or services, and this use does not indicate any partnership, sponsorship, approval or any other connection with them.

If you own a trademark or another right and believe that any content on the site infringes that right, write to contato@kronografx.com stating which content and which right are involved. We will review the request and, if appropriate, adjust or remove the content.

The site doesn't show prices and doesn't close contracts. Here's how it works:

  • First contact: you tell us your idea through one of our channels. Requesting a proposal does not oblige you to hire us.
  • Written proposal: before starting any work, we send a proposal with scope, deadline and price, as well as the revision rounds and the other conditions of that project. The proposal states how long it is valid. If it doesn't, it is valid for 10 days from receipt, as provided in art. 40 of the Código de Defesa do Consumidor – CDC (Brazil's Consumer Protection Code).
  • Project start: work only begins after you approve the proposal or sign the contract.
  • Changes: if the scope, deadline or price needs to change, this will be agreed with you in writing beforehand.

The commitments we publish on the site about the way we work apply to all projects: a written proposal before starting, agreed revision rounds and online service. The portfolio projects show work already completed; the style, length and deliverables of each new project are defined in the proposal.

If you hire us as a consumer, you will have all the rights guaranteed by Lei nº 8.078/1990 (the CDC). This includes the right of withdrawal (art. 49): since the hiring is done remotely, you can withdraw within 7 days from the approval of the proposal or the signing of the contract. To do so, just let us know by emailing contato@kronografx.com or via WhatsApp. Any amounts you have paid will be refunded immediately, with monetary adjustment (inflation correction).

To hire us, you must be 18 or older (or legally emancipated), or be represented or assisted by your legal guardian.

For each project, the proposal or contract prevails over these Terms in matters relating to the service, always respecting the rights the law guarantees you.

To quote or produce a project, you may send us a briefing, texts, logos, images, videos, music and other files. When you do so:

  • you declare that you have the right to use these materials and to share them with us for this purpose, or that you have authorization from whoever holds that right, including the people whose image, voice or data appear in them;
  • we use these materials to talk to you, prepare the proposal and produce the contracted project. We keep what is necessary for the project history and to comply with legal obligations, as explained in the Privacy Policy;
  • we don't disclose your materials or the project made for you without your authorization, except when required by law or by an order from a competent authority. Showing work in our portfolio is always agreed with the client.

We ask that you not send passwords, bank details or other people's personal data that are not necessary for the project. The personal data we receive is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

The site's contact buttons lead to other companies' services:

  • WhatsApp (wa.me/5516991220381): opens a conversation with Kronografx with the message “Hello, Kronografx! I saw the website and I'd like to talk about a project.” already written. You can edit or delete the text, and nothing is sent without your confirmation.
  • Email (contato@kronografx.com): opens the email app on your own device.
  • Instagram (@kronografx): opens our profile on the platform.

These services have their own terms of use and privacy policies, which apply when you use them, and we recommend that you read them. Kronografx does not control these services. Therefore, it is not responsible for how they operate or for the data processing they carry out on their own account. What we do with the information you send us is explained in the Privacy Policy.

We do our best to keep the site online, up to date and working well. Even so, it may occasionally go offline or become slow, due to maintenance, hosting or internet failures, or for reasons beyond our control. Depending on your connection, videos may also take longer to load.

We may update, change or remove pages, texts and portfolio projects at any time, for example to add new work. These changes do not affect approved proposals or contracts signed with you.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or reduces rights that the law guarantees you, in particular those provided for in the CDC. Kronografx is liable for any damage it causes, as provided by law.

Subject to this limit, Kronografx is not responsible for:

  • third-party services, such as WhatsApp, Instagram and your email provider (see “Third-party links and services”);
  • problems caused by your device, browser, software or internet connection;
  • damage caused by the use of the site or its content in breach of these Terms or the law;
  • specific business results of a video, such as sales, views or followers, unless expressly guaranteed in the proposal or contract.

Each party's responsibilities in a contracted project are defined in the proposal or contract, always within what the law allows.

The processing of personal data follows Lei nº 13.709/2018 (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais, the LGPD). In short:

  • the site has no forms or sign-up, and its code doesn't use cookies, audience analytics tools or advertising pixels;
  • fonts and videos are hosted on the site's own server, and the pages don't load scripts, fonts, videos or content from other sites;
  • as with any website, the hosting server may log technical access data, such as IP address, date and time, page accessed and type of browser or device. If the hosting uses any technical resource such as cookies, this will be disclosed in the Privacy Policy;
  • the data you send us when you get in touch is used to reply, prepare proposals, produce contracted projects, issue the nota fiscal (the official Brazilian tax invoice), comply with legal and tax obligations and keep the business history.

This is just a summary. The details, including your rights as a data subject and how to exercise them, are in the Privacy Policy. If there is any difference between this summary and the Policy, the Policy prevails. The site is not aimed at children or adolescents.

We may update these Terms when the site, our services or the law change. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page, and important changes will be highlighted here on the site.

The version published at the time you use the site is the one that applies. Changes to these Terms do not alter the conditions of proposals already approved or contracts already signed.

These Terms are governed by Brazilian law, including the CDC (Lei nº 8.078/1990), the Marco Civil da Internet (Lei nº 12.965/2014, Brazil's Internet Civil Rights Framework), the LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), the Lei de Direitos Autorais (Lei nº 9.610/1998) and the Lei de Propriedade Industrial (Lei nº 9.279/1996).

If you have any problem, talk to Kronografx first: we want to resolve it in the best possible way. This is an invitation, not an obligation: at any time, you can turn to consumer protection agencies, such as Procon (Brazil's public consumer protection agency), or to the courts.

If you are a consumer, you may file any lawsuit in the courts of your place of residence, as guaranteed by the CDC. In project contracts, the venue, if any, will be the one stated in writing in the proposal or contract, always respecting this right.

If any part of these Terms is held invalid, the remaining parts continue in full force.

Have questions, suggestions or requests about these Terms? Contact Kronografx (CNPJ 69.317.795/0001-62):

  • Email: contato@kronografx.com
  • WhatsApp: +55 16 99122-0381
  • Instagram: @kronografx

See also our Privacy Policy.

privacidade.intro_html:
This Privacy Policy explains, in a straightforward way, how Kronografx processes the personal data of people who visit the kronografx.com website and of people who contact us through our channels. It follows the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (Lei nº 13.709/2018 – LGPD, Brazil's General Data Protection Law) and the Marco Civil da Internet (Lei nº 12.965/2014, Brazil's Internet Civil Rights Framework).

The rules for using the site and our services are in the Terms of Use.

secoes.corpo_html:
• The site doesn't ask for or store anything you type. There is no form, sign-up, login, client area, newsletter, store or payment.
  • The site's code doesn't set cookies and doesn't use audience analytics tools, advertising pixels or other trackers. Fonts and videos are hosted on the site's own server, so your visit doesn't send data to any companies other than the hosting provider (and the infrastructure services it uses to deliver the site).
  • Technical access data (such as IP address, date and time, and page accessed) may be logged by the hosting provider, as happens with any website.
  • You decide whether you want to talk to us. Contact happens via WhatsApp, email or Instagram. We receive whatever you choose to send us, plus the profile information those services show us (such as your name and photo).
  • We use your data to reply to you, prepare the proposal, carry out the contracted project, keep a record of our service history with you and comply with legal obligations, such as issuing a nota fiscal (the official Brazilian tax invoice). We don't sell your data.
  • You have rights over your data and can exercise them at any time, free of charge, by emailing contato@kronografx.com.

This summary is here to make reading easier, but it doesn't replace the full text below.

secoes.titulo: Who is responsible for your data
secoes.corpo_html:
The party responsible for processing your personal data (the “controller”, under the LGPD) is Kronografx, registered with the CNPJ (Brazil's National Registry of Legal Entities) under no. 69.317.795/0001-62, a motion design, VFX (visual effects) and post-production studio serving clients all over Brazil 100% online.

For any matter regarding privacy and data protection, write to contato@kronografx.com. This is our communication channel with data subjects and the preferred channel for requests related to this policy, because it keeps a record of your request and of our reply. The other channels are listed in the “Contact” section at the end of this page.

1. When you just browse the site

The Kronografx site is a static page: it doesn't ask for or store anything you type, because there is nowhere to type. Even so, as with any website, the hosting provider may automatically log technical access data, such as:

  • IP address;
  • date and time of access;
  • page or file accessed;
  • type of browser and device.

This data is used only to keep the site running securely and to comply with the law. We don't use it to build profiles or for advertising.

2. When you contact us

The site's buttons and links open external services: WhatsApp (with the pre-written message “Hello, Kronografx! I saw the website and I'd like to talk about a project.”), your email app or Instagram. From then on, we receive whatever you choose to share, for example:

  • name, phone number and email address (and, on WhatsApp and Instagram, the profile information that is visible to us, such as your name and photo);
  • the company you work for or represent;
  • project details, briefing, references and files;
  • the history of conversations, proposals, approvals and deliveries.

If you hire us for a project, we also process the data required to issue the nota fiscal (for example, full name or corporate name and CPF, the Brazilian individual taxpayer ID, or CNPJ).

3. Other people's data in project materials

Videos, photos, audio, briefings and other files sent for a project may contain third parties' data, such as the image and voice of people who appear in recordings. In these cases, the client is the one who decides how this material will be used, and Kronografx acts as a processor: it processes this data on the client's behalf, solely to carry out the project, following the instructions received and protecting the material. Kronografx is liable for anything it does in breach of the LGPD or of those instructions. It is the client's responsibility to ensure they have the necessary authorizations to use this material.

If you appear in material of this kind and want to exercise your rights, you can contact us: we will forward the request to the responsible client and help with whatever falls to us.

Showing the finished work in the site's portfolio is a separate use, which only happens when the client authorizes it.

4. Sensitive data

We don't ask for sensitive data, such as information about health, religion, political opinions, racial origin or biometrics. We ask that you not send this kind of information unless it is essential for the project. In that case, sensitive data will be processed only in the cases set out in art. 11 of the LGPD or, when it is contained in the client's materials, according to the client's instructions, in our capacity as processor.

secoes.titulo: What we use your data for
secoes.corpo_html:
• Replying to your messages and answering questions about our services;
  • Preparing the written proposal, with scope, deadline and price, before starting any work;
  • Carrying out the contracted project, including meetings, revision rounds, approvals and online deliveries;
  • Issuing the nota fiscal and complying with legal, tax and accounting obligations;
  • Keeping the business history (conversations, proposals and projects), to continue serving you and, if necessary, to defend ourselves against any claims;
  • Showing work in the site's portfolio, only when the client authorizes it;
  • Keeping the site running securely, preventing abuse and complying with what the law requires regarding access logs, where applicable.

We don't use your data for other purposes without informing you first and, where the law requires, without asking for your authorization. We don't send advertising messages without your consent.

The LGPD only allows personal data to be processed when there is a legal basis for it. We rely on the following, set out in art. 7º of the LGPD:

  • Preliminary procedures and performance of a contract (art. 7º, V): to respond to your request for a quote, prepare the proposal and carry out the contracted project.
  • Legitimate interest (art. 7º, IX): to serve people who contact us on behalf of a company, keep the business history, show in the portfolio work that the client has authorized us to publish, and keep the site secure, always respecting your rights and what you can reasonably expect from us.
  • Compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation (art. 7º, II): to issue the nota fiscal, comply with tax and accounting obligations and retain the site's access logs for the period set out in art. 15 of the Marco Civil da Internet, when such retention is required.
  • Regular exercise of rights (art. 7º, VI): to defend ourselves, if necessary, in judicial, administrative or arbitration proceedings.
  • Consent (art. 7º, I): only when we ask for your authorization for something specific. In that case, you can withdraw your consent at any time.

Sensitive data is processed only in the cases set out in art. 11 of the LGPD. When Kronografx acts as a client's processor, the legal basis for the processing is defined by the client, who is the controller.

We don't sell, rent or assign your personal data. It is shared only when necessary for the purposes of this policy, with:

  • the site's hosting provider (and the infrastructure services it uses to deliver the site), which keeps the site online and may log technical access data;
  • email, messaging and social media services used to talk to you (such as WhatsApp and Instagram) and online tools for meetings, storage and file transfer used in the project;
  • the accounting firm (if any) and the nota fiscal issuing system, to comply with tax and accounting obligations;
  • public authorities and the Judiciary, when there is a legal obligation, a request from a competent authority or a court order.

We share only the data needed in each case, and we seek to work with suppliers that adopt good security and data protection practices.

Some services we use to talk to you and work on the project, such as WhatsApp and Instagram (owned by Meta), email services and online file storage tools, may process and store data on servers outside Brazil. The same may happen with the site's hosting provider.

These transfers take place only in the cases set out in art. 33 of the LGPD, mainly when they are necessary to perform the contract or the preliminary procedures you requested, to comply with a legal obligation or for the regular exercise of rights (art. 33, IX). When these cases do not apply, the transfer must rely on the mechanisms recognized by the LGPD and regulated by the ANPD (Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados, Brazil's National Data Protection Authority) in Resolução CD/ANPD nº 19/2024, such as standard contractual clauses. When you use these services, their respective privacy policies also apply.

secoes.titulo: How long we keep your data
secoes.corpo_html:
We keep data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes of this policy, according to these criteria:

  • Site access logs: when they exist, they are held by the hosting provider, for the period it adopts. When retention is required, it is done confidentially, in a controlled and secure environment, for the 6-month period set out in art. 15 of the Marco Civil da Internet (Lei nº 12.965/2014), or longer if there is a request from a competent authority or a court order.
  • Contacts that didn't become a project: for as long as needed to reply and follow up on the conversation and, after that, for up to 24 months after the last contact, to make it easier to serve you again. You can request deletion before then, at any time.
  • Contracted projects: while the project is being carried out and, afterwards, for the period required by tax and accounting legislation and for the legal periods during which claims about the contract may still arise.
  • Project files and materials: for the period agreed with the client or needed for adjustments and new versions. The client can request deletion, subject to legal obligations.

Once the period ends, the data is deleted or anonymized, except when the law allows or requires it to be kept.

We adopt reasonable technical and administrative measures, appropriate to Kronografx's size and to the type of data processed, to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or misuse. The way the site itself was built also helps: since it has no forms, sign-ups or trackers, almost no personal data passes through it.

No system is completely secure. If a security incident occurs that may pose a significant risk or harm to you, we will notify you and the Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD), as required by the LGPD.

secoes.titulo: Your rights and how to exercise them
secoes.corpo_html:
The LGPD (art. 18) guarantees you, as a data subject, the right to:

  • confirm whether we process your data;
  • access the data we hold about you;
  • correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data;
  • request the anonymization, blocking or deletion of data that is unnecessary, excessive or processed in breach of the LGPD;
  • request the portability of your data to another provider, in accordance with ANPD regulations;
  • request the deletion of data processed based on your consent, except when the law allows it to be kept;
  • know which public and private entities we share your data with;
  • be informed about the possibility of not giving consent and about the consequences of not doing so;
  • revoke consent at any time;
  • object to processing carried out on another legal basis, if it is in breach of the LGPD.

How to exercise them: send an email to contato@kronografx.com saying what you would like. To protect your data, we may ask for information confirming your identity before fulfilling the request. Requests for confirmation and for access to data are answered immediately, in simplified form, or within 15 days, by means of a complete statement (art. 19 of the LGPD). Other requests are handled within the timeframes set by the LGPD and ANPD regulations. If we cannot fulfill a request (for example, because the law requires us to keep certain data), we will explain why. This service is free of charge.

We don't make decisions about you on a solely automated basis.

Complaints to the authorities: if you believe your rights have not been respected, you can file a complaint with the Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD) through the website gov.br/anpd. As a rule, the ANPD asks you to show that you contacted us first and that the request was not resolved (art. 55-J, V, of the LGPD), so please talk to us first: we want the chance to resolve it. You can also turn to consumer protection agencies, such as Procon (Brazil's public consumer protection agency), as provided in art. 18, §8º, of the LGPD.

The Kronografx site's code doesn't set cookies or store data in your browser (such as local storage) and doesn't use similar technologies, such as tracking pixels or audience analytics and advertising tools.

We also don't load fonts, videos, maps or other third-party content: everything comes from the site's own server. That's why there is no cookie notice for you to accept.

If we ever start using cookies or tools of this kind, we will update this policy and, where the law requires, ask for your consent beforehand.

The Kronografx site and services are not directed at children and adolescents. Apart from project materials sent by clients, we do not, on our own initiative, intentionally collect data from people under 18. If we learn that we have received, through direct contact, data from a child or adolescent without the authorization of their parents or guardians, we will delete it.

When a project uses the image or voice of children or adolescents, the processing must serve their best interests (art. 14 of the LGPD), and it is the client's responsibility to obtain the authorizations required by law, such as the consent of one of the parents or of the legal guardian in the case of children. Kronografx processes this material only as described in “Other people's data in project materials”.

The site has links that open other companies' services: WhatsApp, Instagram and your email app. When you click, you leave the Kronografx site and start using these services, which have their own terms and privacy policies and process your data on their own account. We recommend that you read their policies; Kronografx does not control how these services process your data.

The pre-written WhatsApp message is only sent if you decide to send it, and you can edit it beforehand. The data you send us through any of these channels, however, is processed by Kronografx in accordance with this policy.

We may update this policy to reflect changes to the site, our services or the law. The date of the last update is always shown at the top of this page. If a change is significant, we will give prominent notice on the site and, where the law requires, ask for your consent.

Questions, requests or complaints about privacy and data protection:

  • Email (preferred channel): contato@kronografx.com
  • WhatsApp: +55 16 99122-0381
  • Instagram: @kronografx

See also the Terms of Use. This policy is governed by Brazilian law.
